annotations.text: CORE — cross-league Trade Center as seen from /core. The PREVIEW STATE switcher (Analyzed / Degraded data / Format blocked / Multi-team / Cross-platform) is for review only; in the product those are situations the same page falls into on its own. Multi-team and cross-platform have no backing schema yet.
MOBILE — the same page at 390px. No fake status bar: the phone draws its own. The action row sticks above the real /core tab bar; every tap target clears 44px.

LEAGUE — the Trades tab inside one league. Needs-your-action first, then your own trades (active / completed), then every trade in the league with both sides' realized grades, then the trade block. A letter is withheld (—) with the reason whenever an asset could not be priced.
